intervals.label: funded; in design
intervals.note: Earliest dated source calling PICO-500 'funded' (arXiv:1806.01417, submitted 4 June 2018, which also says it is 'currently in the design phase'); the funding decision date is not published in the sources read. The official page says 'full funding from CFI and the Canadian provinces' and (captures of February 2022 and 15 April 2024) that the collaboration 'is currently working on the final design'.
intervals.quote: supernova neutrinos via CEνNS using the example of the funded PICO-500 experiment

intervals.label: assembly and construction at SNOLAB (Cube Hall)
intervals.locator: UCLA Dark Matter 2025 abstract (talk of 26 March 2025)
intervals.note: Start is not published. The PICO-500 page of 15 April 2024 still says the collaboration 'is currently working on the final design'; the 26 March 2025 talk abstract says it 'is in the process of deploying PICO-500'; the official page (16 December 2025) says it 'is in the process of assembling and constructing the detector'; SNOLAB's 26 May 2026 report lists in-situ welding and testing of the pressure vessel as completed and the PICO talk of 20-24 July 2026 says 'Construction is well underway'. The planned end is the start of commissioning: PICO's July 2026 plan is fluid fill in early 2027 and commissioning 'mid-to-late 2027' (slide 16), which supersedes SNOLAB's 26 May 2026 'commissioning toward the end of 2026' and the 2025 abstract's 'late 2026'; see the log's Conflicts.
intervals.quote: The PICO collaboration is in the process of deploying PICO-500, a large 250 litre chamber filled with C3F8 at SNOLAB

placements.locator: PICO-500 page (Internet Archive capture of 16 December 2025)
placements.note: Cube Hall of SNOLAB; the SNOLAB underground-lab point is used. Installation start is undated.
placements.quote: PICO and SNOLAB are working together to facilitate the experiment’s construction in the “Cube Hall”, the second-largest experimental hall in the laboratory.

target_medium.locator: PICO-500 page (Internet Archive capture of 16 December 2025)
target_medium.quote: PICO is planning to operate PICO-500 with C3F8

summary.plain: A large upright bubble chamber, about 250 litres of superheated C3F8 in a quartz vessel, being built inside SNOLAB's Cube Hall.
summary.technical: Right-side-up design scaled up from PICO-40L: ~250 L active volume, synthetic quartz vessel (the largest silica jar made for a bubble chamber), stainless-steel pressure vessel suspended in SNOLAB's Cube Hall; assembled underground because of its size.

technology.locator: PICO-500 page (Internet Archive capture of 16 December 2025)
technology.quote: PICO-500 will have an active volume of about 250 litres and will use a synthetic quartz vessel, just like PICO-2L, PICO-60 and PICO-40L before it.
technology.value: Right-side-up superheated C3F8 bubble chamber in a synthetic quartz vessel
